links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy using AI combined with traditional resources vs primarily AI
links.effect: Accuracy 87.1% blended vs 82.4% AI-assisted; difference not significant (OR 0.69, 95% CI 0.41–1.16, p=0.209). Missed diagnoses 6.7% blended vs 14.3% AI-assisted; misdiagnosis 6.2% vs 3.3%.
links.quote: The difference between AI-assisted and blended learning was not statistically significant (OR = 0.69, 95% CI: 0.41–1.16, p = 0.209).

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy with blended versus AI-assisted learning
links.effect: Accuracy was 87.1% (blended) versus 82.4% (AI-assisted); AI-assisted versus blended OR = 0.69, 95% CI: 0.41–1.16, p = 0.209. Unaided skill retention was not assessed.
links.quote: The difference between AI-assisted and blended learning was not statistically significant (OR = 0.69, 95% CI: 0.41–1.16, p = 0.209).
